_about: AI behaviour evals. Each case: who says what (after optional setup), the tool calls expected (all must happen; [] means none beyond `allow`), tools that must not happen, argument checks, and reply checks. Every reply also gets the PDA check at the speaker's strictness and a no-score check. Cases whose `requires` tools aren't built yet are skipped. See README.md.
